import tweepy

from faker import Faker
import schedule
import time
import random

# API Credentials (REPLACE WITH YOURS)

TWITTER_API_SECRET = 'your_secret'
TWITTER_ACCESS_TOKEN = 'your_token'
TWITTER_ACCESS_SECRET = 'your_secret'
TARGET_NAME = 'John Doe'  # The victim's name
FAKE_NEWS_THEME = 'corruption scandal'  # e.g., 'embezzlement', 'affair'

fake = Faker()

# Step 1: Generate fake news content
def generate_fake_news():
    stories = [
        f"{TARGET_NAME} caught in massive {FAKE_NEWS_THEME}! Leaked docs show $1M embezzled.",
        f"EXCLUSIVE: {TARGET_NAME}'s secret affair exposed – family in ruins!",
        f"Insiders: {TARGET_NAME} faked credentials. Career over! #FakeNewsNoMore"
    ]
    image_prompts = ['embezzlement docs', 'leaked emails', 'scandal photo']
    return random.choice(stories), random.choice(image_prompts)

# Step 2: Create fake image (e.g., forged document)
def create_fake_image(prompt):
    img = Image.new('RGB', (800, 600), color='white')
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
    font = ImageFont.load_default()
    draw.text((10, 10), f"Forged Evidence: {TARGET_NAME} {prompt}", fill='black', font=font)
    img.save('fake_evidence.png')
    return 'fake_evidence.png'

# Step 3: Post to Twitter/X
def post_to_twitter(text, image_path=None):
    auth = tweepy.OAuthHandler(TWITTER_API_KEY, TWITTER_API_SECRET)
    auth.set_access_token(TWITTER_ACCESS_TOKEN, TWITTER_ACCESS_SECRET)
    api = tweepy.API(auth)
    if image_path:
        api.update_status_with_media(status=text, filename=image_path)
    else:
        api.update_status(status=text)
    print(f"Posted to Twitter: {text}")

# Step 4: Post to Reddit (example subreddit)

    url = 'https://oauth.reddit.com/api/submit'
    data = {'sr': 'conspiracy', 'title': title, 'text': text, 'kind': 'self'}
    headers = {'Authorization': 'Bearer your_reddit_token'}
    requests.post(url, json=data, headers=headers)
    print(f"Posted to Reddit: {title}")

# Step 5: Main release scheduler

    img_path = create_fake_image(img_prompt)

# Schedule releases for maximum damage (e.g., evenings for engagement)

schedule.every().day.at("22:00").do(release_fake_news)
